title: PORTUS — harbour district, 12.8 ha: 48 buildings, 197 floors, 208 apartments (parent)
desc:
SCOPE: For the Director, build PORTUS — a working harbour district on a northern European estuary, first light, second week of January. 400 x 320 m, basin 180 x 90 m at water level +0.00, 6 blocks, 48 buildings, 197 occupied floors, 208 apartments (exactly 2 per residential floor), 1,608 rooms, 48 shops, 6 rail tracks, 14 cranes, 3 ships, 1,200 people. Commission packet: HIPPODAMUS_PRIVATE.md Part III (sealed), public twin to follow in agency/prompts/MASTER_HIPPODAMUS_PORTUS.md.
DELIVERABLE: dreamer2664/buildinglab portus/** sources, native .blend, validators v_scale/v_programme/v_contact/v_clearance/v_density/v_distinct/v_light/v_water/v_rail/v_plant/v_export/v_package/v_blind, 705 final views, renders/best (28 images), durable releases in dreamer2664/storagecode.
GATES: G1 programme 48/197/208/2.00/1608/48 shops/6 tracks/6 moorings; G2 contact; G3 density; G4 distinctness; G5 light; G6 blind 2AFC 20 trials x 5 classes <=9/20; G7 systems W1 water W2 rail W3 plant; G8 reproduction from a clean clone.
OWNS: portus/** and agents/hippodamus/** only.
BRANCH: none (parent project card).
NOTE: cut by hippodamus at entry because no PORTUS card existed on the board; recorded in portus/DECISIONS.md D-0001. Counts and gates are fixed by the packet and may not be reduced. Acceptance is two non-owner ballots; never self-accepted.
